answers.M6-S1: You should be happy with who you are and not try to change how tall you are, because everyone grows at their own speed.
answers.M6-S2: Because in stories magic only works if you keep it a secret, so telling people would break the spell.
answers.M6-S3: The narrator thinks it's real magic seed that will make him grow. The reader knows growing just takes time and eating healthy food, not seeds.
answers.M6-S4: He is worried about being short and wants to be tall, so he grabs any chance to grow.
answers.M6-S5: Because witches are scary and dangerous, and it was an awful experience for him, so he was afraid to go back.
answers.M6-S6: It shows he is patient and still hopes it will work, so we wonder if he will grow later.
answers.M6-S7: To show that the magic seed really worked for Billy, so the narrator believes it will work for him too.
answers.M6-S8: That Billy wasn't very popular, maybe because he was kind of mean or bragged a lot.
answers.M6-S9: He likes his uncle a lot but doesn't want to be short like him. He wants to grow up bigger.
